title: Causal test-completion obligations stay scheduled indefinitely (43 runner_unavailable, since migration on 2026-11-16)
outcome:
Architect2's read-only diagnosis (note 7765f276 on w-70d8b360cdc3, 06:41Z) of the mailbox_relay_intents rows seen on Central.
- There are 48 causal test-completion obligations, not unsent-mail retries: 43 with reason runner_unavailable, 35 of them migrated.
- Their common 2026-11-16T16:49:24Z timestamp is the migration initialization. The "attempts" count (~7540) counts metadata updates, possibly two per visit without any RPC.
- Only a validated final settlement retires an obligation. There is no age or attempt cutoff, so an obligation that can never complete stays scheduled forever.
- Diagnostics omit the actual runner targets.
Needed: supported, bounded attribution metadata (runner target, last reason) and a safe lifecycle for impossible originals, either quiescence or an explicit, recorded disposition. Never TTL deletion, and never inferred completion.
acceptance: Diagnostics name each causal obligation's runner target and last reason (metadata only), and attempts count actual delivery attempts rather than metadata writes.

An obligation whose completion is impossible leaves active scheduling through a safe quiescence or an explicit recorded disposition, never TTL deletion or inferred completion, shown by a behaviour test that fails before the change.
The review pair is clean, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
